input: Find founder- or family-owned US veterinary clinic groups with 5-30 locations

companies.name: R Veterinary
companies.employees: 51–200 employees; LinkedIn company-size band observed as_of 2026-11-10; underlying update date undisclosed. source_url: https://www.linkedin.com/company/r-veterinary

criteria_evidence.criterion: Founder- or family-owned private company; no PE backing
criteria_evidence.evidence: As_of 2026-11-10 observation, the company explicitly states it is entirely owned by its founding family, identifies Dr. Katie Rericha and James Rericha as founders and owners, and says it has declined outside investment.

criteria_evidence.criterion: US veterinary clinic group with 5–30 locations
criteria_evidence.evidence: The company states that it has grown from its original clinic into ten clinics across Missouri. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation.
LinkedIn identifies Linn Creek, Missouri as headquarters, gives the founding year as 2016, and links to r.vet. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation.

companies.headcount_growth: Two snapshots: founder-reported more than 100 employees as_of 2024-07-26, source_url: https://alpha.creativecirclecdn.com/vernon/files/20240725-150009-250-2024-07-26.pdf ; LinkedIn company-size band of 51–200 observed as_of 2026-11-10, source_url: https://www.linkedin.com/company/r-veterinary . The overlapping range does not establish a growth rate.
companies.traction: Company-reported financial signal: net profit generally ranged from 6–12% during most of its first decade. Historical period described on the careers page; as_of 2026-11-10 observation. Not audited revenue disclosure. source_url: https://www.r.vet/careers
companies.rank_reason: Strongest combination of explicit founding-family ownership, rejection of outside capital, and a directly stated footprint comfortably inside the requested range.

companies.name: Neighborhood Veterinary Centers
companies.employees: 51–200 employees; LinkedIn company-size band observed as_of 2026-11-10; underlying update date undisclosed. source_url: https://www.linkedin.com/company/heynvc

criteria_evidence.criterion: Founder- or family-owned private company; no PE backing
criteria_evidence.evidence: The company's recruiting statement explicitly describes NVC as entirely family-owned and operated, with no investors or outside board members. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation.

criteria_evidence.criterion: US veterinary clinic group with 5–30 locations
criteria_evidence.evidence: The opened official directory lists Nederland, Richmond, Calder, Waller, NASA, La Marque, Wallisville, Lake Charles, South Post Oak, Houston Heights, Groves, Bacliff, and Canyon Lakes, with Texas or Louisiana addresses. This complete opened roster falls within the requested band. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation.
The company profile identifies headquarters in Nederland, Texas, founding in 2018, private ownership status, and gonvc.com as its website. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation.
Local business reporting identifies veterinarian Brady Hanson as NVC's founder and owner. source as_of: 2024-02-15.

companies.headcount_growth: Full-time veterinarian subset: 15 as_of 2023-10-14, source_url: https://vetmed.tamu.edu/dvm-job-fair/wp-content/uploads/sites/88/2023/10/2023DVMJobFairBook.pdf ; 19 as_of 2025-10-18, source_url: https://vetmed.tamu.edu/dvm-job-fair/wp-content/uploads/sites/88/2025/10/2025DVMJobFairFullBook_100925.pdf . These are exhibitor-reported clinical headcounts, not total-company employee counts.
companies.traction: Company-reported operating volume: clinics average 25–35 appointments per day. as_of: 2025-10-18 job-fair profile. source_url: https://vetmed.tamu.edu/dvm-job-fair/wp-content/uploads/sites/88/2025/10/2025DVMJobFairFullBook_100925.pdf
companies.rank_reason: Explicit family ownership and absence of outside investors, a complete regional clinic roster within the size band, and dated clinical staffing evidence.

companies.name: Healthy Pets of Ohio
companies.employees: 201–500 employees; LinkedIn company-size band observed as_of 2026-11-10; underlying update date undisclosed. source_url: https://www.linkedin.com/company/healthy-pets-of-ohio

criteria_evidence.criterion: Founder- or family-owned private company; no PE ownership
criteria_evidence.evidence: The company explicitly describes itself as family-owned, locally operated, and independent rather than corporately owned. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation.

criteria_evidence.criterion: US veterinary clinic group with 5–30 locations
criteria_evidence.evidence: The company directly states that it operates eight full-service animal hospitals in Central Ohio. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation.

The history identifies founder Dr. Hal Taylor Sr., subsequent leadership by his son, and continuing leadership by grandson Dr. Hal Taylor III. It dates the original practice to 1952. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation.
LinkedIn identifies Powell, Ohio as headquarters and classifies the company as privately held. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation.

companies.traction: Customer-retention signal: a published testimonial from Ronda L. describes using the group's Wedgewood practice since 2009, including major surgeries. Testimonial publication date undisclosed; as_of 2026-11-10 observation. source_url: https://www.healthypetsofohio.com/
companies.rank_reason: Clear multigenerational ownership, an explicitly stated operating footprint, and a concentrated regional network.

companies.name: Callanan Veterinary Group
companies.employees: 51–200 employees; LinkedIn company-size band observed as_of 2026-11-10; underlying update date undisclosed. source_url: https://www.linkedin.com/company/callanan-veterinary-group

criteria_evidence.evidence: The current company website describes continuing Callanan-family ownership and operation across four generations. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation.

criteria_evidence.criterion: US veterinary clinic group with 5–30 locations
criteria_evidence.evidence: The current website explicitly states five full-service hospitals: Medford, Watertown, Dorchester, Somerville, and Warwick. Boarding and daycare services are not counted as additional veterinary clinics. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation.
The company profile identifies Watertown, Massachusetts as headquarters, founding in 1926, private-company status, and the matching website. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation.

companies.traction: Customer-retention signal: the company's published testimonial from Joan Gumbleton reports more than 40 years as a customer. Testimonial publication date undisclosed; as_of 2026-11-10 observation. source_url: https://callananveterinarygroup.com/
companies.rank_reason: Direct family-ownership evidence and a current, explicitly stated hospital count. The current company roster takes precedence over an older LinkedIn roster.

companies.name: Symbios Animal Health

criteria_evidence.criterion: Founder- or family-owned private company; no PE backing
criteria_evidence.evidence: The company explicitly states that its hospitals are entirely independently and family owned, with no corporate parent or outside investors. Owners identified are Drs. Nick and Elizabeth Pope and Dr. Jan Cailles. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation.

criteria_evidence.criterion: US veterinary clinic group with 5–30 locations
criteria_evidence.evidence: The company explicitly identifies six New Jersey hospitals: Clover Hill, Hunterdon Hills, Oldwick, South Branch, Bedminster, and Symbios Chatham. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation.

The group website describes a coordinated network offering general veterinary care, urgent care, surgery, dentistry, and specialty services. The Chatham hospital is treated as a group location, not substituted for the entire company.

companies.traction: Location-level customer signal: the group website displays a 4.8 rating from 309 Google reviews for its Hunterdon Hills hospital. Company-published review snapshot observed as_of 2026-11-10; not independently recounted. source_url: https://www.symbios.vet/
companies.rank_reason: Exceptionally explicit ownership and no-investor statements, with a directly stated operating footprint. Ranked below more fully documented peers because group-level headquarters, founding year, and staffing remain unverified.

companies.name: Community Veterinary Clinic

criteria_evidence.evidence: The history identifies Dr. Current as owner and founder and repeatedly states that the network remains locally and family owned rather than corporately controlled. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation.

criteria_evidence.criterion: US veterinary clinic group with 5–30 locations
criteria_evidence.evidence: The company explicitly states five Ohio locations: Sidney, Troy, Piqua, Dublin, and Plain City. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation.
The matching group history dates its first clinic to 1992. This is the Dr. Current-owned Ohio network, not the similarly named Community Veterinary Partners consolidator.

companies.traction: Published customer evidence includes an anonymous client account describing successful treatment of two dogs with parvovirus. This is company-hosted customer feedback, not independently verified clinical-outcome data. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation. source_url: https://mycommunityveterinaryclinic.com/history/
companies.rank_reason: Exact match on family ownership and the lower location threshold, supported by a clear company history. Group-level staffing and headquarters were not sufficiently verified.

companies.name: Rocklin Park Veterinary Hospital, Inc.

criteria_evidence.evidence: The company identifies Dr. Bikram Basra as its owner, states that he opened the original business in 2004, and explicitly describes its mission as preserving privately owned veterinary hospitals. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation.

criteria_evidence.criterion: US veterinary clinic group with 5–30 locations
criteria_evidence.evidence: The current directory lists Rocklin Ranch, Sunrise Boulevard, Bowman, East Sacramento, Bayside, MarketPlace, Cherry Creek, Allure, Rocklin Ranch at Pacific Street, and Lincoln Hills. All are California veterinary practices. This complete opened roster falls within the requested band. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation.

criteria_evidence.criterion: Principal office and exact legal entity
criteria_evidence.evidence: A California registry-derived profile identifies the corporation's principal office at 2201 Plaza Drive, Rocklin, and lists Basra as CEO, CFO, director, and secretary. Registry snapshot as_of: 2025-07-15. The corporation was filed in 2007; the company's stated business origin is 2004.

companies.traction: Expansion signal: the company's history reports adding Lincoln Hills in March 2025 and Rocklin Ranch at Pacific Street in June 2025. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation of the acquisition history. source_url: https://www.rocklinparkvet.com/about-us/
companies.rank_reason: Named founder remains the identified owner, and the current practice roster fits the size criterion. Current group-wide employment and funding information were not verified.

companies.name: Veterinary United
companies.employees: 201–500 employees; LinkedIn company-size band observed as_of 2026-11-10; underlying update date undisclosed. source_url: https://www.linkedin.com/company/veterinaryunited

criteria_evidence.evidence: The company's leadership page explicitly identifies Thomas Bankstahl and Julie Bankstahl as owners. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation.

criteria_evidence.criterion: US veterinary clinic group with 5–30 locations
criteria_evidence.evidence: The opened ownership directory lists 26 veterinary practices for Veterinary United and identifies Thomas Bankstahl and family as the owners. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation.

The official roster identifies veterinary hospitals in Michigan and Florida and gives the group office as 42822 Garfield Road, Clinton Township, Michigan. Boarding resorts and the mobile service are separately identifiable. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation.
The matching company profile gives the founding year as 1999 and headquarters as Clinton Township, Michigan. Its ownership-type tag was not used to establish ownership.

companies.traction: Named practice-partner signal: Berkley Animal Clinic's site leader describes growth into a multi-doctor practice after joining Veterinary United in November 2015. Undated company-hosted testimonial observed as_of 2026-11-10. source_url: https://veterinaryunited.com/
companies.rank_reason: Named family owners and a footprint within the requested range. Ranked lower because it is nearer the upper size limit and the consolidated count relies on a secondary ownership directory.

companies.name: Noah's Animal Hospitals
companies.employees: 201–500 employees; LinkedIn company-size band observed as_of 2026-11-10; underlying update date undisclosed. source_url: https://www.linkedin.com/company/noah's-animal-hospitals

criteria_evidence.evidence: The company describes itself as family owned and locally operated, identifies Dr. Michael Thomas as founder, and classifies itself as privately held. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation.

criteria_evidence.criterion: US veterinary clinic group with 5–30 locations
criteria_evidence.evidence: The company recruiting site describes eight hospitals in Central Indiana. The consumer website states ten service locations, including separately branded services sharing addresses. Both descriptions fall within the requested band; co-located services are not treated as separate physical sites.

The official directory lists general practice, low-cost surgery, urgent care, and emergency operations in the Indianapolis area and shows the shared Westside/VSEC West and Stop 11/VSEC South addresses. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation.
The company profile identifies Indianapolis as headquarters, founding in 1982, and the matching domain. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation.

companies.traction: Professional-validation signal: the company's recruiting site describes its network as AAHA-accredited small-animal practices. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation; accreditation was not independently re-audited. source_url: https://noahs-animal-hospital-llc.prismhr-hire.com/
companies.rank_reason: Clear family-ownership statement and qualifying regional hospital scale. Physical hospitals and separately branded co-located services require careful count normalization.

criteria_evidence.evidence: The opened ownership directory reports ten mapped hospitals. The official roster corroborates the Washington network and identifies Redmond as opening November 17, 2026, after the research date; that pending opening is not treated as operating.
The company's own history states that Peter Brown founded Cara in 2018. This takes precedence over older directories reporting a different year.
The matching company profile identifies Seattle, Washington as headquarters and classifies the business as privately held. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation.

companies.traction: Named institutional partnership: Cara announced annual wellness examinations and vaccinations for all six Seattle Fire Department therapy dogs, corroborated by a reposted Seattle Fire Foundation announcement. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation. source_url: https://www.linkedin.com/company/cara-veterinary-1
companies.rank_reason: Qualifying regional footprint and documented family ownership. Ranked lower because current ownership identification relies partly on a secondary source rather than an explicit current cap-table statement.

companies.name: The Nave Veterinary Group
companies.employees: Reported staffing components as_of 2025-10-18: 175 full-time veterinarians, 200 licensed technicians, and 200 other staff. Both descriptions fit the requested band, but the exact consolidated count is inconsistent across public pages.
The company homepage states establishment in 1974. The group's exhibitor profile supplies its office address in Las Vegas, Nevada; office-address source as_of 2025-10-18.

companies.headcount_growth: Full-time veterinarian subset: 118 as_of 2022-10-01, source_url: https://vetmed.tamu.edu/dvm-job-fair/wp-content/uploads/sites/88/2023/03/2022DVMJobFairBookFINAL.pdf ; 175 as_of 2025-10-18, source_url: https://vetmed.tamu.edu/dvm-job-fair/wp-content/uploads/sites/88/2025/10/2025DVMJobFairFullBook_100925.pdf . These are exhibitor-reported veterinarian counts, not total-company employee growth.
companies.traction: External recognition of the group's founder-owner: the University of Missouri selected James Nave as commencement keynote speaker and honorary Doctor of Science recipient as_of 2025-05-18. This is founder recognition, not a company revenue metric. source_url: https://cvm.missouri.edu/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/CVM-May-2025-commencement-program-1.pdf

criteria_evidence.criterion: US veterinary clinic group with 5–30 locations
criteria_evidence.evidence: The official location directory lists Nashville, East Nashville, Lawrenceville, McLean, and Falls Church. This complete opened roster meets the requested band. as_of: 2026-11-10 observation.

companies.last_round: Last financing listed by Owler: $350,000 Debt–PPP (CARES Act), April 2020. Financing as_of: 2020-04; source observed 2026-11-10. This is debt assistance, not an equity round; no more recent financing was verified. source_url: https://www.owler.com/company/value-vet
companies.traction: Low-confidence third-party financial signal: Owler estimates annual revenue at $4 million. Revenue measurement year is undisclosed; as_of 2026-11-10 observation only. Not a company-confirmed or audited figure. source_url: https://www.owler.com/company/value-vet
companies.rank_reason: Direct family-ownership statement and a qualifying official clinic roster. Ranked last because founding information, growth history, and financial enrichment are less complete, and hiring copy is not fully synchronized with the official location directory.

output.search_notes: Research cutoff: 2026-11-10. These are the qualifying companies verified during this research, not a guaranteed exhaustive census of every US operator. Rankings prioritize explicit ownership evidence, a verifiable operating footprint, and source completeness—not an assessment of clinical quality or investment returns. Unless a historical date is supplied, as_of 2026-11-10 means the page was observed during this research, not that its underlying data was updated that day. Complete named rosters are preserved where an official directory does not publish a numerical total. Planned openings, mobile service territories, boarding-only facilities, and duplicated co-located services were not intentionally counted as additional clinics. Sources included company ownership/history/location pages, company-authored recruiting profiles, Texas A&M veterinary job-fair exhibitor books, local business reporting, university publications, and registry-derived records. LinkedIn size bands are estimates, not payroll counts. Public ownership statements are not substitutes for direct cap-table diligence. PE exclusions included O'Brien Veterinary Group despite its family-owned marketing: Cambria lists the veterinary business in its portfolio, source_url: https://cambriagroup.com/portfolio/obrien-veterinary-management . My Pet's Vet Group was excluded because Fulcrum identifies it as a fund investment, source_url: https://www.fulcrumep.com/portfolio-details/my-pets-vet-group/ . VetnCare was excluded after checking Great Point Partners' current portfolio and its July 2026 portfolio-company announcement, source_urls: https://www.gppfunds.com/private-equity/portfolio-case-studies/ and https://www.gppfunds.com/vetncare-announces-acquisition-of-holistic-veterinary-care/ . These exclusions apply even where founders remain involved. Other exclusions included Lakefield, whose own site states more than 80 locations, source_url: https://lakefieldvet.com/our-story/who-we-are/ ; and Curo, for which the opened ownership directory lists a footprint exceeding the upper limit, source_url: https://www.privateequityvet.com/vet-list/?region=US . No financing announcement found does not mean that a company has never borrowed or raised capital. Missing_fields by company: R Veterinary=[last_round]; Neighborhood Veterinary Centers=[last_round]; Healthy Pets of Ohio=[headcount_growth,last_round]; Callanan Veterinary Group=[headcount_growth,last_round]; Symbios Animal Health=[hq,founded_year,employees,headcount_growth,last_round]; Community Veterinary Clinic=[hq,employees,headcount_growth,last_round]; Rocklin Park Veterinary Hospital, Inc.=[employees,headcount_growth,last_round]; Veterinary United=[headcount_growth,last_round]; Noah's Animal Hospitals=[headcount_growth,last_round]; Cara Veterinary=[headcount_growth,last_round]; The Nave Veterinary Group=[last_round]; Value Vet=[founded_year,headcount_growth]. Additional limitations: R Veterinary's dated staffing snapshots do not establish a growth rate; NVC and Nave growth figures cover full-time veterinarians only; current total-company employment for Nave is unverified. Rocklin's headquarters field uses the registry-derived principal office rather than an inconsistent aggregator headquarters label. Veterinary United's LinkedIn ownership-type tag was not relied upon because the company's own leadership page identifies its owners. Cara's pending Redmond opening on November 17, 2026 was excluded from operating-location assessment.
